notes.thiamine_proton_lock_evidence: Checked on 2026-10-22 with every partner at its MetaNetX 4.5 pH 7.3 form, and recomputed by the thiamine phosphate chemistry audit: the reaction balances as written, H+ included. pH 7.3 equation: thiamine(1+) + ATP(4-) = thiamine diphosphate(2-) + AMP(2-) + H+.
notes.thiamine_proton_lock_evidence_tier: verified on 2026-10-22 by in-memory balance checks; the proton gate dry run on ef2265c1 removes this H+ because the residual is exactly one H+ under the KEGG forms
notes.thiamine_proton_lock_rationale: The H+ is correct for the pH 7.3 convention the pipeline is moving to. Under the current mixed forms, KEGG fully protonated thiamine phosphates and HET-P with neutral ATP, ADP, AMP and phosphate, the reaction is off by exactly that H+; it balances only when all of these move to pH 7.3 together. The lock keeps the proton/water gate, from the 2026-10-22 microspecies.py on, from removing it, also on a model read back from SBML.
notes.thiamine_proton_lock_previous_state: no proton lock; the gate would remove the H+
